instruction: Complete the task using command-line or batch-capable tools from Altium Designer, OrCAD Capture, or OpenSCAD. The neutral PCB package `hsd_fpga.ipc2581` is on the desktop. Export differential-pair gap and tuned-length information. Requirements: - Write the required deliverables into `C:\Users\user\Desktop\result`. with pair name, negative net, positive net, and gap. - Write the required deliverables into `C:\Users\user\Desktop\result`. with negative length, positive length, and absolute delta for every pair. Use CSV header `Pair,Negative,Positive,Gap_mil`; key `tuned_lengths.json` by pair name with `negative_mil`, `positive_mil`, and `delta_mil`. [Software] At the start of the task, the available entry points are OrCAD Capture at `C:\Cadence\SPB_24.1\tools\bin\Capture.exe`, Altium Designer at `C:\Program Files (x86)\Altium\AD17\DXP.EXE`, and OpenSCAD at `C:\Program Files\OpenSCAD\openscad.exe`.
